mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_async_task (id, task_type, payload, status, retry_count, error_msg, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskType}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{errorMsg}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_async_task SET status = #{newStatus}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE skill_async_task SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND retry_count < #{maxRetry}
